steps: Boil the potato and beetroot in separate pans until a knife slides in easily; the beetroot can take about 40 minutes.
Peel both, then mash the potato and grate the beetroot.
Heat the oil in a pan on medium, add the mustard seeds, cumin and hing, and let them crackle.
Add the chopped onion, green chilli and ginger and cook on medium for 2 to 3 minutes, until the onion softens.
Add the turmeric, potato, beetroot and salt and mix on low for about 2 minutes.
Take it off the heat and stir in the chaat masala, lemon juice and chopped coriander leaves.
Butter the bread, spread the filling on one slice and cover with the other.
Toast on a tawa on medium-high for about 3 minutes a side, or in a sandwich maker, until crisp and golden.
note: No site has this exact family sandwich, so I joined the Mumbai aloo masala toast filling with grated beetroot mixed in, the way beetroot tikki does it. Grating the beetroot into the potato keeps it from sliding out and turns the filling pink.
